author: More Perfect Union
description:
Waitress and dairy farmer Rebecca Cooke has flipped a Wisconsin House seat.

Cooke ran on saving local dairy farms, fighting data centers, and her own working class bonafides.

She's part of a new crop of economic populists who could reshape Congress.
title: This waitress and dairy farmer just FLIPPED a U.S. House seat
